issues.on_page: Non-Revenue Receipts 308,613.07; Depreciation Fund portion 306,272.30 includes '5200 Allocation from General Fund' 300,000.00 (p21)
issues.issue: 300,000 is coded 5200 (the transfers code) and the General Fund side appears as 'Property' spending in 2650 (100,000) and 2710 (200,000) on p36, so the same money is counted as both receipt and spending. The report itself does not eliminate it, so keeping it as printed is defensible (review already set), but the treatment is inconsistent with detail (see next issue).
